column2: DEDUCTIONS FROM INTEREST PAID BY BANKS AND FINANCIAL
(1) Every bank or financial institution shall, subject

column1: to the other provisions of this Act, deduct from the interest
payable or creditable or from the discount allowable by it, on
any sum of money deposited with it, income tax at the rate of
ten per centum on the amount of such interest or discount;
such deduction shall be made at the time such interest is paid
or credited or such discount is allowed.
